preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM global_property WHERE property = 'bahmni.sqlGet.getBedServiceConcept'

changeSet.comment: Ward name → bed fee concept for IPD admit/transfer billing (atomfeed → Odoo IPD shop)

insert.column: SELECT c.uuid AS uuid, cn.name AS name FROM concept c JOIN concept_name cn ON cn.concept_id = c.concept_id AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.voided = 0 WHERE c.retired = 0 AND cn.name = CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(${name})) LIKE '%hdu%' OR LOWER(TRIM(${name})) LIKE '%icu%' OR LOWER(TRIM(${name})) LIKE '%first%' THEN 'Bed patient first class +meal procedure' ELSE 'Bed patient standard+meal procedure' END LIMIT 1;

column.name: description
column.value: Returns bed fee concept uuid/name for a ward (${name}). Used by IPD admit/transfer to create Bed Service orders.

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_type_class_map m JOIN order_type ot ON ot.order_type_id = m.order_type_id WHERE ot.name = 'Bed Service'

changeSet.comment: Map Bed Service order type to Misc Order class (Radiology/Procedure already taken by UNIQUE concept_class_id)
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO order_type_class_map (order_type_id, concept_class_id) SELECT ot.order_type_id, cc.concept_class_id FROM order_type ot JOIN concept_class cc ON cc.name = 'Misc Order' WHERE ot.name = 'Bed Service' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order_type_class_map m WHERE m.order_type_id = ot.order_type_id AND m.concept_class_id = cc.concept_class_id );

changeSet.author: ethbahmnicore

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM concept_name cn JOIN concept c ON c.concept_id = cn.concept_id JOIN concept_class cc ON cc.concept_class_id = c.class_id WHERE cn.name = 'Bed patient standard+meal procedure' AND cn.voided = 0 AND cc.name = 'Radiology'

changeSet.comment: Reclassify bed fee concepts as Misc Order so they can be ordered as Bed Service
changeSet.sql: UPDATE concept c JOIN concept_name cn ON cn.concept_id = c.concept_id AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.voided = 0 JOIN concept_class misc ON misc.name = 'Misc Order' SET c.class_id = misc.concept_class_id, c.changed_by = 1, c.date_changed = NOW() WHERE cn.name IN ( 'Bed patient standard+meal procedure', 'Bed patient first class +meal procedure' );
